title: Enhance screenreader semantics and contrast tokens for data components
creator: Maya Chen
description: Audit and remediate accessibility gaps across data-heavy components (tables, charts, table-controls, compact buttons). Deliver token updates, ARIA semantics, keyboard behaviors, and a VPAT-ready draft for the DS release. Work spans design tokens, component specs, and companion developer guidance.
background: Recent internal accessibility sweep found multiple issues in sortable/virtualized tables and chart tooltips: missing semantic roles, unstable keyboard focus when rows are re-ordered, and failing contrast ratios on compact buttons and selected-row states. We need a coordinated design + engineering effort to close these gaps before the ds-2026.03 release and to provide evidence for our VPAT update.
goals: Bring table and chart components up to WCAG 2.1 AA for text and UI contrast where applicable
Provide clear ARIA roles and live-region announcements for sort/filter/pagination actions
Ensure predictable keyboard navigation for virtualized and sortable tables (arrow, home/end, page navigation)
Update token palette for interaction states (focus, hovered, selected) and publish migration notes
Produce a VPAT-ready draft page with screenshots and test steps for reviewers
scope: Primary: Table components (Table, VirtualizedTable, SortableHeader), Table controls (column menus, pagination)
Primary: Charts (bar/line/area) accessible labels, legend keyboard access, and tooltip announcements
Primary: Compact/ghost buttons used inside table rows and action columns (contrast + focus ring)
Design token updates that affect the above components and documentation updates in the component spec
out_of_scope: Full product-wide VPAT certification (this ticket delivers DS artifacts used by compliance team)
Non-data components (modals, forms) unless they share the same tokens or patterns
Localization or RTL-specific keyboard flows (separate follow-up)
acceptance_criteria: Table headers expose role=columnheader and aria-sort updated when sorting occurs
Sortable controls announce changes via a polite aria-live region: 'Sorted by <column> ascending/descending'
VirtualizedTable preserves DOM focus and provides programmatic focus when rows are re-rendered
Arrow keys move between cell-level interactive elements; Home/End go to first/last cell; shift+arrow for range selection documented
Chart SVG elements have accessible titles/desc and legends are keyboard-focusable with visible focus ring
Contrast tokens: primary-compact-button, row-selected-bg, row-hover-bg meet at least 3:1 for UI components and 4.5:1 for text labels where applicable
Design token PR merged and component spec pages updated with examples and migration notes
VPAT draft completed with test evidence (screenshots, code snippets, automated axe/pa11y output)
design_decisions: Prefer semantic table markup (<table>/<thead>/<tbody>) for small tables; virtualized tables will use role=grid with explicit row/cell roles and keyboard guidance
Add a single polite aria-live region at the top of table container to avoid multiple repetitive announcements
Separate tokens for 'ui-contrast-3' (3:1) and 'text-contrast-4-5' (4.5:1) to make purpose explicit
Use a 2px high-contrast focus ring for keyboard focus on interactive chart legend items and compact buttons
Document recommended developer patterns for keeping focus after item reorder (expose focusAfterReorder API hook)

notes: Spike showed that third-party virtualization lib needs a small adapter to expose row DOM node when it is remounted
We decided against per-cell aria-labeling for large datasets due to performance; prefer row-level actions with explicit labels
Design token change will be a semver-minor since it affects visual states; include migration notes and codemods for DS consumers
